shots.focal_element: Green gradient 'Data & AI Engine' circle badge at lower centre with a cluster of motion-blurred dashboard cards behind it
shots.typography: Badge label in a geometric sans, semibold, title case, two centred lines, white on gradient; dashboard text too small/blurred to judge
shots.what_happens: A scattered stack of small, motion-blurred dashboard cards collapses into a single dashboard panel behind the glowing 'Data & AI Engine' badge on a dark vignette backdrop (0.7 s bridge shot, words w81-w84 'with purpose-built AI').
shots.build_rebuild: Over a dark radial-vignette background, animate 8-10 small UI card thumbnails converging (with motion blur) into one dashboard panel positioned behind a circular gradient badge with a thin outer ring reading 'Data & AI Engine'.

shots.focal_element: Recreated analytics dashboard: 'AI Visibility Over Time' stacked area chart plus Revenue and Bounces metric cards
on_screen_text: Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep
shots.typography: Clean grotesque sans throughout; bold sentence-case card titles, large medium-weight numerals for metrics, small regular labels; normal tracking
shots.what_happens: The camera pushes through the badge and the full dashboard scales up to fill most of the frame; the Revenue metric counts up 83K -> 124K -> 146K -> 153K -> 156K while Bounces drops 6K -> 4K and a marker travels along the area chart, then the panel washes towards white at the end (w85-w90 'you can capture AI visibility faster').
shots.build_rebuild: Scale a flat-vector dashboard (sidebar icons, area chart, two KPI cards with up/down arrow badges, line chart, donut legend) from the badge position to ~80% frame width, then tween the Revenue number 83K->156K and Bounces 6K->4K with an ease-out count-up over ~2 s.

shots.focal_element: A 5x4 grid of identical-style website wireframe cards with green gradient image blocks
shots.transition_other: Dashboard washes to white, then a tight, oversized view of wireframe cards pulls out (scale-down) into the full grid
shots.what_happens: Starting close on oversized page cards, the view pulls out as the cards settle into an evenly spaced 5-column by 4-row wall of website wireframes on the dark background, representing the customer's content library (w91-w98 'With the industry's first solution to analyze and').
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out 20 white rounded browser-window wireframe cards (title bars, grey text lines, green-to-lime gradient image blocks in varied layouts) in a 5x4 grid and animate the container from scale ~2.0 to 1.0 with ease-out over ~1 s.

shots.focal_element: Four clusters of wireframe cards stacked over coloured circles (olive, green, blue, red), with the word 'LLMs' appearing between them
shots.typography: Large bold geometric sans, mixed case 'LLMs', white, tight tracking; letters type on one by one
shots.what_happens: The grid cards fly into four overlapping clusters, each over a coloured disc that grows in behind it, visualising content clustering; the word 'LLMs' types on centre-left in sync with w107 'LLMs,' (w99-w107 'cluster your content using the same techniques as LLMs').
shots.build_rebuild: Tween each of the 20 grid cards to one of four cluster anchor points with slight random rotation/offset and stagger, scale in a coloured circle behind each cluster, then typewriter the word 'LLMs' letter-by-letter timed to the voice-over word.

shots.focal_element: 'AI Topic Map' bubble chart window; a clicked bubble expands into a red 'content topic PRIORITY' circle, then an opportunities table panel
shots.transition_other: Cannot see the entry at 2 fps; the browser window is already in place at the first frame over a new green-to-yellow gradient background
shots.typography: Grotesque sans; bold title-case window heading, small regular labels in pill tabs and bubbles; 'PRIORITY' in heavy uppercase under a light lowercase 'content topic'; table headers medium weight
shots.what_happens: A cursor travels up into the topic map and clicks the 'Blog 56 K' bubble, which grows into a large red 'content topic PRIORITY' circle; a table window (Page URL / Opportunity / Impact / Monthly Traffic with 'Create Content' / 'Optimize Content' buttons and red 'High' tags) pops up over it and scales forward to become the main panel (w108-w123 'Conductor AI finds your most valuable website content opportunities, then shows you how to capture them').
shots.build_rebuild: Show a flat browser-window mock with a grid bubble chart; animate a cursor to a bubble, on click scale the bubble up and recolour it red with a two-line label, then pop a second window with a 3-row action table in front and push it forward (scale ~1.0->1.25) while the back window stays put.

shots.typography: Very large heavy geometric sans numerals for '5X'; subline in bold uppercase with wide-ish tracking; white, centred
shots.what_happens: The stat blurs in already counting ('4X' at the first frame) and lands on '5X BETTER CONTENT' over a dark-teal to lime gradient with concentric chevron line patterns radiating from centre, then a bright white light-leak flash washes the frame out at the end (w124-w129 'Build five times better performing content').
shots.build_rebuild: Over an animated green-to-yellow gradient with thin concentric diamond/chevron strokes, blur-in and count a big 'NX' number from 1 to 5 landing on the spoken 'five', with a static uppercase subline, and end with a white radial light-leak flash as the exit.
